name: Rotating Savings & Credit Associations (ROSCAs)
summary: Peer-based savings circles where members contribute fixed amounts and take turns receiving the pooled sum; banking without banks.

claims.statement: ROSCAs provide credit access to populations excluded from formal banking systems
The mechanism has independently emerged across dozens of cultures on every inhabited continent

evidence.source: Ardener (1964) The Comparative Study of Rotating Credit Associations
World Bank surveys on informal finance in Sub-Saharan Africa
Besley, Coate & Loury (1993) The Economics of Rotating Savings and Credit Associations

notes: Known as susu (Ghana), chit fund (India), tandas (Mexico), hui (China), stokvel (South Africa). Entirely trust-based, no collateral.
